_comment: Slither configuration for the SRX Token suite. Tuned to suppress framework-noise and surface findings that matter.
_detectors_to_exclude_rationale: naming-convention: OZ + LayerZero use conventions Slither doesn't recognize; not relevant
solc-version: locked to ^0.8.24 intentionally; not a finding
assembly: LayerZero V2 OFT base uses assembly internally; not our code
low-level-calls: BuybackBurner uses .call by design (swap calldata); reviewed in audit
calls-loop: PreSaleRound batchDeployVaults intentionally loops; capped + paginated
unused-state: __gap arrays are intentional UUPS upgrade storage reservation; confirmed false positive
arbitrary-send-erc20: StabilisationFund.recoverLiquidity is admin-only AND safeTransferFrom requires source approval; double-gated. Slither cannot see ERC20 approval state
arbitrary-send-eth: BuybackBurner.rescueETH and SRXTreasury.withdrawETH are intentionally admin-only ETH rescue/withdraw functions. Slither does not recognize OZ AccessControl role gating

reentrancy-no-eth: GuardianModule.pauseAll/emergencyUnpauseAll call admin-registered module targets which are trusted SRX-suite contracts. State writes are timestamps/counters tolerant to call-order anomalies. Trust model documented in MULTISIG_SPEC.md
_filter_paths_rationale: Skip dependencies, test stubs, mocks, and Foundry test code
